title: The Episode About the First Sikh Guni

blocks.text: The fame of Baba Ji’s greatness spread among saints, pirs, and seekers; each received an answer according to the state of his own heart. (50)
Then Baba Ji set out upon udasi, taking Mardana with him and carrying the rabab upon his shoulder. (51)
Wherever Baba Ji felt joy, there he would sing the Shabad with the rabab. (52)
Saints, siddhs, pirs, and disciples came before him in wonder; wherever he went, he spread the remembrance of the True Name. (53–54)
